content:
Maya - Partnerships: Heads-up: StratusOne agreed to a joint launch package: marketplace listing in their Cloud Catalog, a short benchmark blog, and a co-hosted webinar. Looking at June 9-11 for the webinar. Who can lead?
Ethan (Growth): I can run promotional funnel and landing page. Need a short value prop line from product by Fri.
Priya (PM): ICP = platform and infra teams at mid-to-large companies. Benchmark should highlight throughput and tail-latency under steady traffic (simulate 200k tokens/day). StratusOne will provide a sanitized trace.
Rina (Content): I'll take the blog + social copy. Prefer to have metrics + 2 charts and 1 customer quote. Timeline?
Leo K: I'll own the demo and slides. Plan: 12m demo, 8m benchmark walkthrough, 10m audience Q&A. Will need a reproducible script and small demo repo.
Mark S: For lead routing: create SFDC queue `Partners_StratusOne_Webinar`. Tag leads `utm_source=stratusone` and `partner=stratusone`. Can someone spin queue + add Mark + Ethan?
Maya - Partnerships: @Priya can you create the SFDC queue and grant Mark + Ethan write access? Also we'll need a HubSpot static list for the webinar registrants.
Priya (PM): Will do. Note: use `email_lowercase` as dedupe key. I'll post the queue id when ready.
deploy-bot: Event created: "StratusOne + Redwood: Real-world Inference at Scale" 2026-06-10 11:00 PT — https://calendar.company/evt/stratus-9876
Ethan (Growth): Landing headline idea: "Real-world benchmark: scaling inference with StratusOne + Redwood" — keep it factual.
Rina (Content): Keep headline factual. I'll avoid hard %s in headline until the CSV is final. Use a hero subhead for the headline stat.
Leo K: Demo notes: show KV-cache effect, batching, and the smart routing fallback. Need access to their test env by May 25.
Maya - Partnerships: Marketplace brief: short description (100 words), 2 screenshots, co-logo SVG, 3 bullet benefits. StratusOne expects listing live within 10 business days after webinar.
Ethan (Growth): Promo plan: 2 nurture emails pre-webinar, partner cross-post, LinkedIn + X promos, and a paid cohort for enterprise list. Also plan A/B subject lines.
Mark S: A/B test suggestion for subject lines: (A) "Live benchmark: inference at scale" (B) "See how StratusOne reduced serving cost". Run 15% split then roll.
Priya (PM): SFDC queue posted: `Q-7190-Partners_StratusOne_Webinar`. Added Mark + Ethan. Use this id in HubSpot mapping.
Rina (Content): Draft schedule: blog draft by May 22, slides + demo script by May 27, landing + email copy by May 28. Can we compress if StratusOne gets us logs earlier?
Maya - Partnerships: Ask them for CSV + partner quote by May 20. We can accelerate if received.
Ethan (Growth): CTA tracking template: `?utm_source=stratusone&utm_medium=partner_webinar&utm_campaign=stratusone_jun2026`. Use on all CTAs and partner links.
Leo K: Will prepare a small public repo with reproduction steps: `https://git.internal/redwood/stratusone-demo` — will push a branch once ready.
Mark S: Sales 1-pager: I'll draft quick qualifiers: "Monthly token volume? Production SLOs? Regulatory constraints?" Sales ops wants it in Notion + SFDC link.
Rina (Content): Also drafting 3 social soundbites: technical, business, quick stat. Will keep them <120 chars.
Priya (PM): Legal review needed for any partner claims. Please CC Maya once copy is in draft.
Maya - Partnerships: Rehearsal requested by StratusOne: Wed June 3 10am PT. Who can attend?
Ethan (Growth): I'll join rehearsal + prod host. Rina (Content) and Leo (demo) should be there.
Rina (Content): Confirmed.
Leo K: Confirmed. Will run a dry demo at least once with their eng.
Ethan (Growth): Follow-up plan: immediate recording + one-pager with benchmark graphs, then 2-week nurture with product offers. Templates by June 12.
Maya - Partnerships: Action items recap:
- Rina: blog + social soundbites (draft May 22)
- Leo: demo script + slides + demo repo (May 27)
- Ethan: landing + emails + paid promo plan (May 28)
- Priya: SFDC queue (done) + coordinate legal review (May 21)
- Maya: marketplace brief + partner liaison (May 20)
StratusOne deliverables: sanitized workload CSV, partner quote, and co-logo SVG by May 20.
deploy-bot: Reminder set for May 21 09:00 PT: "StratusOne co-marketing asset check"
Maya - Partnerships: Thanks team. If anyone hits a blocker, flag here and I'll escalate. :handshake:
